summary: Regression re-test of iteration_8 fixes: all 3 issues are RESOLVED. (a) Auto-detected pickup no longer blocks the flow — vehicle.tsx now sends 'lat,lng' when place_id is null; hero + fare (₹95) render successfully with 'Current location' as pickup. (b) Tracking driver-card is visible IMMEDIATELY at t=0 with status='searching' — driver-name ('Karthik Rajan') and vehicle-number ('UP 92 JP 2873') visible; avatar shows spinner; call-driver-button correctly hidden until status advances. (c) Summary screen no longer requires goods-note — leaving goods-note-input empty and confirming successfully navigates to tracking. Regression 4 (fully-typed pickup+drop via Google autocomplete) also works — Chennai Central → T Nagar produced fare ₹131 with no errors. Backend pytest: 18/18 pass. E2E happy path works end-to-end on both auto-detect and typed-pickup paths.

issues: Deprecation warnings still present: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' from ToastHost and 'TouchableWithoutFeedback is deprecated' — not blocking, but should be migrated. Repeat from iteration_7 / iteration_8.

action_items: (Optional test-suite polish) test_luxelogistics.py uses `pytest.order_a_id` shared state, which breaks when pytest-xdist LoadScope splits WS tests onto a separate worker. Consider a class-level fixture or run with `-o addopts=` to avoid the false negative under parallel execution. Serial run: 18/18 pass; parallel run: 16/18 pass due to worker isolation only.
